title: Exact constraint blocks of ObjectJointUser in SymbolicSystem.SystemJacobian
author: Claude-JG
description: The constraint blocks of SystemJacobian are central differences (#3141): SolveGeneralizedAlpha with joints is 90 times slower than SolveDynamic and stops at other Newton iterates. C_q is the recorded jacobianUserFunction times the position and rotation Jacobians of the markers, already formed for the reaction forces; the derivative of C_q^T lambda by q from the one-pass derivative of the recordings (#3116), as for the connectors (#3129).
